name: OWA Championship
epitaph: The OWA's own world title, defended by Amazon Woman through the winter of 1995 against Dangerous Dunk, Traci Lane, and Ricky Blood.

name: InterNet Championship
epitaph: Crowned in an eight-man tournament to launch the OWA's InterNet division, changing hands between Colt and Ricky Blood across December 1995.

name: INN Championship
epitaph: The singles title of the OWA's INN branch, billed on Nightmare through the winter of 1995.

name: OWA Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The OWA's tag title, changing hands three times across December 1995 before Freddy Fever and Major Threat won it at WinterTime Massacre.

name: OWA TV Championship
epitaph: The OWA's television title, changing hands repeatedly across 1996 between Amazon Woman, Mariko, Masked Mayhem, Johnny Fate, and Asian Invasion.

name: OWA Trio Tag Team Championship
epitaph: A three-man tag championship held by the stable The Crew, first seen defended at Crime Spree.
